decision: تشاکلی is the natural adjectival form of attested Urdu symmetry noun تشاکل. It identifies mathematical mirror/rotation symmetry rather than vague proportionate balance, and all three UI references now share the exact landscape title. No claim that متناسب is wrong in every ordinary Urdu sense.
